_note: Friendly editorial copy grounded in this group's personas.json. These are jokes, not attributed quotes. Pick-specific copy requires the matching team and direction.

rachel.default: Rachel did not need a big announcement when she picked {team}. If this stretch works out, the family may have to supply the announcement for her. Quiet picks can make very loud receipts.

picks.James Madison|O: Rachel took the James Madison Over while the family was still looking the school up. If the wins arrive, geography class is going to come with a standings update.

john.default: John built arguments for a living. Now {team} needs to supply the evidence. A difficult Saturday may prompt the family to ask whether he would like a brief recess.

picks.Ole Miss|O: John took the Ole Miss Over. For the record: Ole Miss first, LSU second. The family has heard the opening statement; now the Rebels need to produce the evidence.

vic.default: Vic is delighted with Abita Springs. If {team} cooperates, the family gets a football update with the relocation update. If it does not, there is always more to say about Abita Springs.

picks.Mississippi State|O: Vic needs Mississippi State wins. The family should leave a little room at dinner for a Bulldog update, somewhere between the Abita Springs update and the next Abita Springs update.

gayden.default: Gayden does not have a casual setting. If {team} struggles, the family can ask whether the problem is conditioning, technique, or a football team refusing to tap out on schedule.

picks.Michigan State|O: Gayden needs Michigan State wins. The family can debate this pick, but anyone bringing up his Michael Bradley takes should prepare for the conversation to go into extra time.

holly.default: Holly lives surrounded by Alabama and Auburn fans without converting. Whatever {team} does, nobody should mistake a temporary rooting interest for a change of allegiance.

picks.Tennessee|O: Holly needs Tennessee wins. Living in Alabama is already testing her patience; the Vols could at least provide something useful for the neighborhood conversation.

devin.default: Devin already has a World Cup title the family can discuss indefinitely. If {team} helps him toward another trophy, everyone may need a second subject for dinner.

picks.Auburn|O: Devin once looked at a ghost pepper and decided he could handle it. He has now taken the Auburn Over. The family is permitted to keep a glass of milk beside the standings.

gunner.default: Gunner has already lived through the family's World Cup scoring debate. If {team} delivers, he has every reason to request that this trophy come with a very boring rulebook.

picks.Purdue|O: Gunner took the Purdue Over without an elaborate explanation. If it works, the family will have to choose between asking for his method and pretending they saw it coming.

zach.default: Zach wrote the scoring engine, and every family scoring question still comes back to him. If {team} struggles, the commissioner may wish the website had a hide-my-own-picks button.

picks.Wake Forest|O: Zach took his alma mater to the Over. The family should ask whether Wake Forest passed the model's tests or just knew the person administering them.
picks.LSU|O: Zach needs LSU wins. A Baton Rouge upbringing and an elaborate forecasting engine have reached the same conclusion. The family can debate which one did the work.
